We investigate how state-of-the-art neural language models can learn and generalize out of SOCIAL-CHEM-101 to accurately reason about social norms with respect to a previously unseen situation. We term this modeling framework NEURAL NORM TRANSFORMER, and find it is able to generate relevant (and potentially novel) rules-of-thumb conditioned on all attribute dimensions.
